title: Reliquary Map Engine
subtitle: Sample Crypt · engine test bench
intro: Kerra and Pip stand in the dark west hall, Kerra's torch lit. The door east is closed.
tips: The crypt is dark. Kerra's torch lights 20 ft brightly and 20 ft more dimly; Pip has darkvision and sees the rest in grey. Select Kerra and put out the torch to see what Pip alone can see.
Foes in dim light are concealed (half-shaded badge) from PCs without low-light vision or darkvision. In GM view, select a foe the party cannot see to mark it hidden; players see a ? on its square.
In GM view the map is shaded by light level; click a lamp to light it or put it out (the brazier in the north-east room, the lantern on a hook in the south-east room).
Drag Kerra or Pip. The green area is their 25 ft move; the line shows the cheapest route and its cost (5-10-5 diagonals).
Click the hall door on the middle wall to open it, then walk into the doorway. The ogre appears only while someone can see it.
The double door below it is two leaves: click one leaf to open just that one, or Shift+click to open both. Open doors swing on their hinges.
Walk back. The far room stays dimmed: explored, but not visible now.
Look through the portcullis (dashed, lower left) and the window. Sight passes, movement does not.
Switch to GM view and click any token, even the ogre, to see the board through its eyes: only what it perceives now.
In GM view, click the gold secret panel to mark it found, then click again to open it.
In GM view, drag Kerra or a rat into the bone giant (Huge, 3×3): a 1×1 creature may share its space. Try the ogre (2×2): it may not. A 2×2 may share a 4×4's space.
In GM view, drag the three rats (south-east room) into one square. A lone rat sits in the centre; sharing rats take a quadrant each.
